PawPal account and data deletion

To request deletion of your PawPal account and associated data, email support@oru.studio and include the game name (PawPal), platform (Android) and player ID, if available. We will delete cloud-saved progress and associated identifiers. Some data may be retained as required by legal obligations, such as purchase records.
